propositions: A Pass-1 code-review overlay must detect when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes in one adapter (lib, CLI, MCP) without corresponding updates to sibling adapters.

The surface-parity overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and must fire only on diffs touching the three write-surface adapters (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) via glob routing, staying inert on unrelated changes.
The overlay must be wired into both round_a and round_b batches of the four-pass code-review gate workflow so the finder is actually dispatched, not merely registered.

The reviewer prompt must enumerate the three write surfaces, carry false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergences and adapter-bound non-caller-visible parameters (_creation_channel, return_alias, source, repo_root), and produce code_review_findings with criteria ["surface-parity"].
